summary: Reduce mail delivery objective CPU by recapturing only changed source inputs

replay.detail: The producer still reconstructs retained mail lifecycle samples at startup; per-message accounting and acceptance rules are unchanged.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or retained metadata changes.

rules.detail: SLO deadlines, budget windows, holds, ownership, conflict checks and native acceptance semantics are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Native source-input notifications replace broad API wakes. Unrelated notifications no longer recapture retained mail. No wire or client changes.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal daemon upgrade.

recovery.detail: Capture or native observer coverage failures remain unknown/no-data. Reverting restores the previous producer without data migration.
